name: rigworks
description: A no-code creative application framework — a shared data vocabulary for creative applications.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix tools/rig-validate && npm install --prefix tools/site
scripts.check: npm run check:version && npm run check:schemas && npm run check:parity && npm run check:links && npm run check:snippets && npm run check:svg && npm run check:examples && npm run check:site && npm test
scripts.check:examples: node tools/rig-validate/cli.js --strict examples/minimal-scene.json examples/lfo-binding.json examples/ui-panel.json examples/portable-tool.json examples/path3d-spline3d.json examples/page-anchor.json examples/cad-boolean.json examples/story-flow.json examples/bim-model.json examples/bim-bcf.json examples/bim-ids.json examples/font-ufo.json examples/place-address.json examples/person-contact.json examples/plant-taxon.json examples/book-isbn.json examples/paper-citation.json examples/art-object.json examples/commerce-offer.json examples/legal-agreement.json examples/calendar-event.json
